changes.text: Mix loop: only the boards on channel 6, started in vMix; MIX LOOP on again switches at once; Mix counted from 0 by default; loop and next buttons in Show control
Lower third sponsor tab: the logo as big as the tab allows (90 of 116 px high, up to 420 wide), a margin kept round it
MIX LOOP off only stops the switching (board and L-bar stay on the Mix), MIX NEXT works with the loop off, the next board follows the one on the Mix; tickers ON/OFF top right of AFTER / BREAK
Show control: saving one setting no longer puts every other one back to its default (zod 4 partial defaults), which switched the Mix loop off; TEAM PARTNER for a team with one sponsor on the line-ups
Mix loop controls as the break scene's (MIX LOOP on/off, MIX NEXT, its own day schedule and groups); CB VELA key on BEFORE (the CBVela film from its start on channel 7)
Defending champions key (CHAMPIONS on HUN's team page): the team lower third with an editable bottom line; ECU, HUN, PER and CZE keys in their shirt colours
